title: Deep Binding of Language Model Virtual Personas: a Study on Approximating Political Partisan Misperceptions

bias_targets.methodology: Conditioning LLMs with generated interview-style backstories to simulate partisan personas (Democrat and Republican) and administering established multiple-choice political psychology surveys. Bias is evaluated by calculating in-group/out-group perception gaps (e.g., Hostility gap, Subversion gap, and Meta-perception gap) and comparing the effect sizes and response distributions against empirical human data.
